about.text: A large blue sheep cheese from Villanúa in Huesca, named after a Civil War bunker where it was once ripened. Made from raw sheep's milk with Penicillium roqueforti; the paste is perforated during ripening so the mould spreads, and it is sold at 2 to 4 months.
